description: A real Tabata / HIIT interval timer: configurable prep, work and rest seconds, round counter and chime on every interval change.

faqs.a: A high-intensity interval protocol: 20 seconds of all-out work followed by 10 seconds of rest, repeated for 8 rounds (4 minutes). Every interval here is configurable.

faqs.q: Does it keep time in a background tab?
faqs.a: Yes — it uses wall-clock timestamps, so intervals stay accurate even when the tab is not in focus.

faqs.q: What happens after the last round?
faqs.a: The timer chimes and shows “Complete!” — there is no rest interval after the final work round.

howto: Set rounds, work seconds, rest seconds and prep countdown.
Press Start — the timer runs Prep → Work/Rest → … → Complete automatically.
Watch the round counter and the current phase label.
Pause any time, or Reset to start over.
title: Tabata Timer
